entities.name: COMT
observations: The Val158Met polymorphism (rs4680) was evaluated in relation to uterine leiomyoma multiplicity and MED12 exon 2 mutation status.

entities.name: Uterine leiomyoma
observations: In a 2017 study of 104 patients and 59 controls, COMT Val/Val was not significantly associated with leiomyoma overall: OR 1.77, 95% CI 0.81–3.86, p=0.149.

entities.name: Multiple leiomyoma risk
observations: COMT Val/Val was more frequent in multiple than solitary leiomyomas (40.0% vs 20.3%; OR 2.61, 95% CI 1.09–6.24, p=0.028) and versus controls (40.0% vs 18.6%; OR 2.91, 95% CI 1.20–7.06, p=0.016).

entities.name: MED12 mutation independence
observations: Among 32 patients with at least one MED12 exon 2-mutated fibroid and 26 with no mutated fibroid, COMT Val/Val was not significantly associated with MED12 status (OR 0.77, 95% CI 0.23–2.53, p=0.662). The reported multiplicity association applied to both MED12-positive and MED12-negative tumors.

entities.name: PMID:27491313 Heinonen
observations: Primary study of COMT Val158Met, multiple uterine leiomyomas, and MED12 exon 2 mutations; 104 patients and 59 controls.
